answer: Saffron only grows where hands stay all winter. Thirty tundra plots open at the wharf each epoch; a claimant winters one plot six epochs, grading saffron before three strangers, two plots per witness at most. Entry locks 80 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,375 POA. One operator winters two plots at most: ten fakes need five hands and thirty witnesses each epoch for six epochs. A missed grading burns 25 and restarts the winter; hands grading two plots in one hour lose both bonds. The ledger matches grading times to roots: one hand, one winter, one claim.
